source: Brusatte et al. 2010, Science 329: 1481-1485, Fig. 2: phylogenetic relationships of tyrannosauroid theropods against time; a vertical rectangular tree with the root at the bottom, rotated tip names above black range bars (some names in blue), red ghost lineages, black node dots with clade names, a geological time column at the left, silhouettes with dotted leader lines, and a vertical download stamp at the right edge. Image: census figure (2473x2027 px).
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names ('Utah Taxon' as printed)
gold_note: Time-calibrated tyrannosauroid tree, 19 tips, fully resolved. Red segments are ghost lineages on ordinary branches, and the dotted lines join silhouettes to taxa: neither is a branch. Node bars were read from the image rotated root-left and listed per column, then checked against the figure. Random-sample case (seed 20261106); topology only.
